transcript.text: My Dyson V10 Absolute (SV12) won't run at all now. On the battery display there's a red light flashing when I press the trigger, then nothing. It was charging overnight. Do I need a new battery or is the whole thing dead?

I can't confirm what RED LIGHT FLASHI means on your model, so I'll go by what it is doing. From what you have described, the most likely cause is the battery or charger. Check the charger is plugged into a working socket and fully into the vacuum (or the robot is seated on its dock), and wipe the charging contacts clean and dry. Was the charger, socket or contacts the problem (and is it sorted), does the charging light never come on, or is the charger fine with the light on?
The charger light is on and I tried a different socket too, same result. The contacts look clean. Still flashing red when I press the trigger.

[Heading: Likely cause: battery — flat or failed (cordless)]
The checks point to the battery — flat or failed (cordless). I could not find a confirmed match for model V10 ABSOLUTE (SV12) in our parts catalogue, so check with the manufacturer or a parts supplier using the full model number, or ask an appliance engineer to fit it.
